### Simple OLS Regression

Generate an aritificial sample with 2000 observations and the following specifications:
$$y_i = 50 + 3 a - 4b + e_i,$$
where $e_i \sim N(0, 30).$

```{r ols}
set.seed(1) # Reset random number generator
N <- 2000 # Number of observations
ols_data <- data.frame("a" = runif(N, 20, 60), # Uniformly distributed
                       "b" = rnorm(N, 100, 20)) # Normally distributed
y <- 50 + 3*ols_data$a - 4*ols_data$b + rnorm(N, 0, 30)
ols_data <- cbind(y, ols_data)
```

The standard function for regression analysis in R is `lm`.

```{r}
ols <- lm(y ~ a + b, data = ols_data)
summary(ols)
```
